comment: sys/unix/unixmain.c restores an explore-mode game, then calls wd_message(), which prints "You are in non-scoring explore/discovery mode." before y_n("Do you want to keep the save file?"). Before that, restore.c dorecover() calls allmain.c welcome(FALSE), which prints the welcome-back line, do.c hellish_smoke_mesg() (silent on level 1) and dungeon.c print_level_annotation() for the #annotate note made in the first segment. n deletes the save, and two searches follow.
